name: IntroCleanup
short: Deletes intro messages from members who leave the server.
description: Watches #intros and deletes all messages posted by members who leave, are kicked, or are banned. Also provides a sweep command to backfill-clean the existing channel history.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores channel and log channel IDs per guild.
install_msg: Use `[p]introcleanup setchannel #channel` to set the intros channel and `[p]introcleanup setlog #channel` to set the log channel.
author: evacfk
